Check-in

Keyless check-in. Arrive any time after 2 pm.

Every room has a smart lock. Your door code comes to you automatically, so there is no key to pick up and no desk to wait for.

How it works

Three steps

Check-in2:00 pm
Check-out11:00 am

  1. Book online

    Pick your dates and room at book.walkertonlivery.ca. Rates are live and booking is instant.

  2. Get your door code

    Our booking system sends your personal door code automatically before you arrive. No key pickup, no front desk to wait for.

  3. Let yourself in

    Enter your code at the smart lock and you're in. Your code works for your stay only.

Questions

Good to know

What are check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 2:00 pm. Check-out is by 11:00 am.

When do I get my door code?

Our booking system sends it to you automatically before your arrival, using the contact details you book with. Make sure your email and phone number are correct when you book.

I didn't get my code. What do I do?

Check your spam or junk folder first. If it's not there, call or text 226-840-6727 and we'll sort it out.

Does my code work after check-out?

No. Your code is set for your stay only.

Where do I park?

Parking is free. Call 226-840-6727 if you are not sure where to park.

Ready when you are
